reason: It's me plus two freelancers who come and go, so I'd be paying a seat for people who are around half the month, and the moment I add a client or another contractor the bill climbs. Basecamp-style flat pricing lets me invite whoever without thinking, so I'm not switching to per-seat for something that looks similar.
objection: Per-seat pricing punishes me for bringing in freelancers and clients. I'd be counting heads every month instead of just working.
would_change_my_mind: A flat price for the whole workspace around $50 a month, with freelancers and clients as free guests.
